errors.meaning: The command input does not satisfy its installed schema.
errors.recovery: manuvra <command> --help

errors.meaning: The installed registry has no command with this identity.
errors.recovery: manuvra commands list

errors.meaning: The framed request exceeds the one MiB transport limit.
errors.recovery: Move large input to an explicit file-backed command input or reduce it.

errors.meaning: This request ID was already used with different canonical content.
errors.recovery: Generate a new request ID; do not reinterpret the previous request.

errors.meaning: CLI and daemon have no compatible wire protocol version.
errors.recovery: manuvra doctor

errors.meaning: The negotiated registry does not support this command version.
errors.recovery: manuvra commands get <command>

errors.meaning: The local CLI and daemon build or registry digests differ.
errors.recovery: Close active sessions, then follow manuvra doctor recovery.

errors.meaning: The daemon has live sessions or in-flight work and cannot stop or be replaced.
errors.recovery: Inspect manuvra daemon status and close every listed session with its owning installed build.

errors.meaning: The daemon has closed admission while existing work is drained.
errors.recovery: Use manuvra daemon status; close listed sessions or wait for in-flight work to finish.

errors.meaning: The requested target is not currently discoverable.
errors.recovery: manuvra targets

errors.meaning: The process, tab, or window generation no longer matches the session.
errors.recovery: Discover the replacement target and open a new session.

errors.meaning: The daemon has no active session with this ID.
errors.recovery: manuvra open --target <target-id>

errors.meaning: The requested session is already closed and cannot be reused.
errors.recovery: manuvra open --target <target-id>

errors.meaning: The session has admitted work that must become terminal first.
errors.recovery: Wait for the original result or cancel it before closing.

errors.meaning: Another session currently owns the target actor lease.
errors.recovery: Wait for release/expiry or use an observer session.

errors.meaning: This command mutates or may mutate and requires actor authority.
errors.recovery: manuvra lease acquire --session <session-id>

errors.meaning: The session actor lease expired before dispatch.
errors.recovery: manuvra lease acquire --session <session-id>

errors.meaning: Actor ownership could not be proven after possible dispatch.
errors.recovery: Observe the target before attempting ownership recovery.

errors.meaning: The installed adapter does not implement this known command.
errors.recovery: manuvra commands get <command>

errors.meaning: This exact target does not currently advertise the required capability.
errors.recovery: manuvra targets

errors.meaning: Google Chrome is missing or could not be spawned at the dedicated macOS application path.
errors.recovery: Install Google Chrome at /Applications/Google Chrome.app, then run manuvra chrome launch

errors.meaning: The loopback debugging port is occupied by a listener that is not Chrome CDP.
errors.recovery: Free the loopback debugging port, then run manuvra chrome launch

errors.meaning: A required macOS permission is not granted to the installed daemon identity.
errors.recovery: manuvra doctor

errors.meaning: The requested action cannot execute honestly in background mode.
errors.recovery: Retry the same intended action with --mode foreground only if visible input is acceptable.

errors.meaning: Exact semantic resolution found no matching element.
errors.recovery: manuvra observe query --session <session-id> <semantic locator>

errors.meaning: Exact semantic resolution found multiple matches and no winner was selected.
errors.recovery: Observe matches and act through one issued element reference.

errors.meaning: The element reference is outside its active session/target/reference epoch.
errors.recovery: Observe again and use a newly issued reference.

errors.meaning: Screenshot geometry or target identity no longer matches the point locator frame.
errors.recovery: Capture a new screenshot and use its frame token.

errors.meaning: The backend primitive was not dispatched.
errors.recovery: Inspect diagnostics and retry with a new request only after the condition changes.

errors.meaning: The backend rejected the primitive without accepting it.
errors.recovery: Inspect the backend code and command help.

errors.meaning: The backend failed without proving that no target effect occurred.
errors.recovery: Observe the target and inspect detailed diagnostics.

errors.meaning: The backend connection failed after the command may have been sent.
errors.recovery: Observe the target; never blindly replay the mutation.

errors.meaning: The monotonic request deadline expired after possible dispatch.
errors.recovery: manuvra observe screenshot --session <session-id>

errors.meaning: Cancellation became terminal after dispatch or possible dispatch.
errors.recovery: Observe the target before issuing another mutation.

errors.meaning: Foreground input ownership or target continuity was interrupted.
errors.recovery: Observe and explicitly re-establish foreground conditions.

errors.meaning: Dispatch was confirmed but the post-action state did not settle in time.
errors.recovery: Observe the current target state before deciding whether more action is needed.

errors.meaning: Dispatch was confirmed but required screenshot capture failed.
errors.recovery: manuvra observe screenshot --session <session-id>

errors.meaning: Required post-action observation is incomplete.
errors.recovery: Observe the target explicitly and inspect diagnostics.

errors.meaning: A required artifact or manifest could not be committed.
errors.recovery: Inspect diagnostics and current target state before retrying any mutation.

errors.meaning: Artifact export or checksum verification failed.
errors.recovery: Choose a writable destination and export before session close.

errors.meaning: The backend returned its native protocol error for the exact raw request.
errors.recovery: Inspect the preserved raw response artifact.

errors.meaning: A native Accessibility value cannot be represented by the accepted tagged JSON schema.
errors.recovery: Inspect diagnostics; no lossy string conversion is available.

errors.meaning: The durable usage file is not valid JSON or violates its schema.
errors.recovery: manuvra commands usage export <destination>, then reset if desired

errors.meaning: The installed build cannot read this usage schema version.
errors.recovery: Export the preserved file and use a compatible build or reset explicitly.

errors.meaning: The implementation could not construct a valid bounded operational result.
errors.recovery: Preserve diagnostics and report an implementation defect.

errors.meaning: An internal invariant failed and effects cannot be classified more narrowly.
errors.recovery: Observe the target, preserve diagnostics, and report the defect.

warnings.meaning: The raw operation ran, but opt-in usage counting was suspended because durable usage state is unavailable.
